name: ruff
description: An extremely fast Python linter and code formatter, written in Rust.
one_liner: A tool that automatically checks Python code for mistakes and messy style, and fixes most of it instantly.
buyer: An engineering manager with a large, aging Python codebase who wants consistent code quality without hiring more human reviewers.
business_use_cases: A dev-tools consultancy runs flat-fee 'codebase cleanup' engagements: install Ruff, fix everything it flags, hand back a modernized repo.
A platform-engineering freelancer wires it into every client's CI pipeline as part of a broader DevOps retainer.
A training company teaches 'modern Python tooling' workshops built around adopting Ruff (and the rest of the Astral toolchain) at a company.

money_ideas.idea: Ongoing CI/platform-engineering retainer that includes it

steal_this: Offer a few Python shops a flat-fee 'run Ruff across your repo and fix everything it finds' service this weekend.
